title: TFM - Bayesian Network Agentic RAG
summary: A master's-thesis project building an agentic RAG system over scientific literature about Bayesian networks, with a pipeline for OCR ingestion, hybrid retrieval, and conversational querying of a paper corpus. One ingested source paper in the corpus describes using SDV's CTGANSynthesizer to generate synthetic oncology trial data, but the repository itself never imports or runs SDV.
